missions.name: 01  /  INITIATION
missions.description: A controlled assessment at the fictional Civic Evaluation Annex.
missions.briefing: Ruby: Blackline doesn't hire on a promise. Disable the assessment unit, recover its three records, and leave through the marked exit. Stay observant; the guards are part of the evaluation.
missions.debrief: Ruby: You kept your head. Blackline can use that. The next file is already on your desk.

missions.name: 02  /  THE MERIDIAN
missions.description: Trace a missing archive through a luxury hotel.
missions.briefing: Ruby: Ivo Chen manages the Meridian's records. Find him and ask about the missing archive, then bring back two records. The Covenant is interested too; we don't know why yet.
missions.debrief: Ruby: Chen's account and the records point beyond the hotel. The Covenant is not our employer, and I intend to learn who is paying them.

equipment.name: Training sidearm
equipment.description: Unsuppressed fictional assessment pulse. Five charges; Q uses one.

equipment.name: Quiet line
equipment.description: Temporarily disables one nearby person without graphic effects. Q uses it.
